relationships: Course has many Modules in order
Student enrolls in Course via Enrollment
Submission receives a Grade from Instructor
Certificate belongs to Student for a completed Course
Discussion belongs to Course or Lesson
Announcement belongs to Course, sent to all enrolled Students

layout.notes: Course builder on desktop is the power feature — it needs the most screen real estate. On iPad the course builder uses the full right panel. On iPhone course building is read-only overview — creation happens on larger form factors.

avoid: Never auto-publish a course — always require explicit publish action
Never show student data to other students — isolation is absolute
Never delete a submission — only archive
Never auto-grade subjective assignments — always require instructor review
Never send bulk emails without preview and confirmation
Never use a percentage as the only grade indicator — show points earned of total alongside
Never truncate assignment instructions — full instructions always visible on submission screen
Never hide submission deadline — always prominent on assignment and student view
enforce: Course publish state always visible — Draft / Published / Archived badge at top
Module drag handle always visible — left side of module row
Auto-save indicator always shown when editing course content — 'Saved X seconds ago'
Student progress percentage always calculated from completed lessons / total lessons
Assignment deadline always shown in student's local timezone
Plagiarism warning shown if detected before grade is returned
Certificate issued notification always sent to student — never silent
Grade return notification always sent to student — never polling required

empty_states.ui: Graduation cap illustration. Message: 'Create your first course'. CTA: 'New course'. Secondary: 'Import existing course'. No empty dashboard metrics.
Module area shows: 'Add your first module'. Drag hint shown. Template suggestions: 'Introduction / Core content / Conclusion' as quick add.
People illustration. Message: 'No students enrolled yet'. Sub: 'Share your course link to get your first students'. CTA: 'Copy course link'. Bulk enroll option secondary.
Gradebook table shows column headers (student name, assignments). Rows show enrolled students with 'No submissions' state — not empty table.

loading_states.ui: KPI cards skeleton — 3 cards in row. Course list skeleton — 3 course rows with thumbnail, title, student count placeholder.
Module accordion skeleton — 3 collapsed modules with handle, title, lesson count. Lesson editor loads content progressively.
Column headers load first. Student rows skeleton — name left, grade cells right. Cells shimmer individually as data loads.

error_flows.ui: Auto-save indicator turns red: 'Save failed'. Retry button appears. Content preserved in local state. Warning: 'Leave page? Unsaved changes will be lost.'
Upload progress bar turns red. Message: 'Upload failed'. Retry with resume from interruption point if possible. Other lesson content preserved.
Grade not recorded. Red inline error. Student not notified. Form stays open. Retry option. Local copy of grade preserved.
Waiting room message: 'Having trouble starting the session'. Auto-retry 3 times. Option to send message to students: 'Session delayed — joining in X minutes'.

edge_cases.ui: Student list paginated — 50 per page. Gradebook virtualised. Bulk actions with progress indicator. Export always available for large datasets.
Submission marked 'Late' with timestamp. Late penalty automatically applied if configured. Instructor can manually override penalty with reason.

edge_cases.case: Course with no paid content (all free)
edge_cases.ui: Pricing section hidden. Enroll button shows 'Enroll free'. Certificate still available. No paywall UI shown anywhere.

edge_cases.case: Instructor grades their own test submission
edge_cases.ui: Warning: 'You are grading your own test submission'. Grade recorded but flagged as self-graded. Not counted in student averages.
